newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Edison shuts down nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Edison shuts down nuclear plant.

text.p: Detroit Edison Co said its Fermi 2 nuclear power plant will remain shut down for at least four weeks to determine whether an electrical component failure damaged the plant's main generator.
The component failure in the switchyard outside of the plant on the shores of Lake Erie near Monroe, Mich., resulted in current entering the generator from the Detroit Edison electrical system.
Detroit Edison said the incident did not affect operation of the Fermi 2 reactor, which continued to operate at eight percent power until it was shut down early Saturday.
